chapter: The Meadow (meadow) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (#904): a hummable mid-register guitar lead the ear can follow, a tune that goes through a second section and a build, the sunshine carried by warm guitars and a steady beat rather than by shrill, toy-like highs
purpose: Master of Game/Music/bloom-sunny.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-917-chosen on the desktop, with its .raw.wav; it is masters-909/probe917-sunny-britney-c1 renamed); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-r.ps1 (#909-#917, adapted from the #908 batch) -> Tools/Generation/generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption
format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

request.caption: In the style of Britney Spears: Sunny feel-good pop-rock instrumental with a hummable tune: a warm clean electric guitar playing a simple memorable melody a listener could hum back, strummed acoustic guitar and warm electric piano chords under it, a round warm bass guitar, a steady upbeat pop drum groove on kick, snare and toms with a dark ride cymbal, a gentle first section with the tune over the strumming that lifts into a fuller second section where a second guitar harmonises the tune and the drums drive harder, then a build into the last chorus, optimistic and friendly, warm mid-forward mix, modern production, wide stereo mix with guitars panned left and right, the full band playing throughout, no vocals
request.lm_negative_prompt: vocals, singing, choir, audience applause, crowd noise, live recording, bouncy plucked synth, synth arpeggio, arpeggiator, chiptune, toy piano, music box, glockenspiel, bells, childish, cute, sugary, shrill, squeaky, whistle, one-bar loop, boomy sub bass, bright crash cymbals, splashy cymbals, open hi-hats, tambourine, shakers, long drum-only sections, drum solo, quiet breakdown, near silence, fade in

The drums layer re-separated from the baked loop: drums -19.1 dBFS against the recording's -16.5, calm peak 0.64.

chosen: The owner's pick in the blind A/B test of #917 (2026-10-28, the verdict page of 2026-10-27): of the shipped Sunny (#904's plain brief) and this render of the same brief with "In the style of Britney Spears:" before it, he chose this one, and asked for it in the game. The other three pairs of the test went to the plain brief; this is the one exception.
